newsitem.title: UK: Vietnam plans 33 new sugar mills by end-century.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam plans 33 new sugar mills by end-century.

text.p: Vietnam plans to build 33 new sugarcane mills by the year 2000 while allowing foreign companies to invest all the required capital, the deputy director general of Vinasugar II said on Wednesday.

This would bring the national total to 49, with 32 in the south and 17 in the north of the country, said Nguyen Van Chap in a prepared speech to a two-day conference hosted by the International Sugar Organization (ISO).

He said four joint-venture companies and one enterprise with 100 percent foreign-owned capital had already been licensed for producing sugarcane and sugar. By the end of the century, cane processing capacity would increase to 99,850 tonnes per day from 20,150 tonnes at present.
